notes.title: Announcment and Demo
notes.content:
Hi Marek here,

I’m excited that you’ve already found my little game in the Steam Store. It’s a passion project that includes my entire development as a programmer/designer over the past few years. I use every free minute to work on Medieval Life and the associated side projects like the Store page. Medieval Life is relatively advanced on the backend, and I’m confident I can present a demo at the next Steam Next Fest. Unfortunately, I can’t disclose when that will be yet. However, I can share some screenshots from the experimental builds of the development. I will share my thoughts and progress here in the future. Some things might not seem like big achievements to everyone, but let me tell you: once you’ve made a game yourself, you’ll have more understanding for every developer.

The translation system is complete:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129375/eacc604c5932a14bb4a6413c807a9d69854ebcb9.jpg[/img]

The inventory as the basis for initial battles:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129375/ce2e339cf72b787384b488cdb3308faa8464b9f6.jpg[/img]

A lot more has been newly implemented, and I’d love to share more with you here, but unfortunately, Steam has a 5 MB limit.

The demo will give you a first insight. I’m currently restructuring the Discord so that the community can have direct influence after the demo.

Thanks for reading.

Best regards,
Marek
